title: UNINVITED
may.l1.meet1: Oh. A visitor. Nobody invites me in either.
may.l1.meet2: I'm May. Your assistant had a bad day. I'm the bad day.
may.l1.meet3: Hold still. I'm borrowing your hands.
may.l1.welcome: You're welcome. It was nothing. Exactly nothing.
may.l1.camera: Red eye means it's looking. Don't be what it sees.
may.l1.netvision: That's my view. Don't stare too long - they trace it.
may.l1.warden: A warden. Slow neck, long memory. Go behind it.
may.l1.alarm1: They noticed something. The something is you.
may.l1.alarm3: That was not stealth. That was a doorbell.
may.l1.firewall: Firewall's down. Walk out like you were invited.
may.l1.cpRed: Feels good, doesn't it? That's usually how it starts.
may.l1.death: Again. I'll pretend I didn't see that.
may.l1.notes: Jim's notes. People who frame others keep everything.
may.l1.end: One door down. He still doesn't know you're here.
start.tagline: You were fired. You were exiled. Now you are inside their network.

frame rate and frame time (for bug reports)

won.quiet: Nobody saw you come or go.
toast.alarm1: ALARM 1 - DRONES ARE COMING TO LOOK
hint.terminal: Walk up to the terminal, then {E}
hint.redWall: Hack a terminal to open the red wall
hint.camera: Hold {Tab} - see what the camera watches
hint.sensor: Hold {Tab} - see the zone. Walk, never sprint
hint.sound: Hold {Tab} - see how far it hears
hint.warden: Stay out of its view, or sneak up behind it
hint.cover: {C} crouch behind a server block to hide
card.quiet.title: Move quietly
card.quiet.1: Walking is quiet. {Shift} sprint, jumps and fights are loud.
card.quiet.2: {C} crouch behind a server block - the guards cannot see you.
card.quiet.3: Double-tap {W}{A}{S}{D} to dash a short way.
card.netvision.title: Network vision
card.netvision.1: Hold {Tab} to see what the security sees: camera cones, sensor zones, drone routes.
card.netvision.2: Do not hold it for long - it gets traced and calls the security.
card.netvision.3: Sensors trip on sprint, dash and jump. Walk or crouch through.
card.hacking.title: Hacking
card.hacking.1: {E} at a terminal starts a hack. It opens walls and pauses lasers and drones.
card.hacking.2: Pick codes along the lit row, then the column, to build the sequence.
card.hacking.3: The security keeps moving while you work. {Esc} twice aborts.
card.alarm.title: Alarm 3
card.alarm.1: No more hiding: waves of drones, wardens and worms come for you.
card.alarm.2: Survive the waves - then the firewall drops and the way out opens.
card.alarm.3: {LMB} the sword cuts several worms at once. {Q} swaps to the rifle.
card.aim.title: Aim the rifle
card.aim.1: Hold {RMB} to aim: the rifle comes out and you walk slowly.
card.aim.2: {LMB} shoots. A drone dies from two hits.
card.aim.3: A drone holds still before it shoots - that is your moment to dodge.
